title: Interpretable distance-resolved graph learning for cancer gene priority screening
title_zh: 可解释距离分辨图神经网络用于癌症基因优先级筛选
abstract: Systematic screening for cancer genes (CGs) is still a central goal in precision oncology, yet integrating sparse and spatially dispersed oncogenic signals to identify testable candidates remains challenging. Here we present CGMap, an interpretable graph-learning framework that uses a width-oriented parallel architecture to prioritize potential CGs from biomolecular networks and trace mechanistic cues. By constructing distance-resolved channels, CGMap localizes spatially dispersed CG signals across multiple topological scales while avoiding representation homogenization. A global diffusion module quantifies gene cooperativity along pathway contexts and yields traceable virtual interactions that map predictions to potential regulatory hypotheses, providing intrinsic interpretability for model decisions. Across multiple biomolecular networks in a pan-cancer setting, CGMap analysed 12,022 genes, consistently outperformed existing methods while remaining computationally efficient and prioritized 70 reliable candidates, including those previously unannotated in established databases. Importantly, the prioritized candidates were associated with the suppression of tumour-related phenotypes, including reduced cell proliferation, migration and invasion, along with a shift of epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT)-related features toward a non-mesenchymal state, as supported by parallel loss-of-function assays across cancer and non-malignant cell lines. Wang et al. propose CGMap, a distance-resolved graph-learning framework that maps dispersed oncogenic signals into structured priorities, narrowing the cancer gene candidate space and establishing an interpretable path from hypotheses to practical validation.
abstract_zh: 系统性筛选癌症基因（CGs）仍然是精准肿瘤学的核心目标，但将稀疏且空间分散的致癌信号整合以识别可检验候选基因仍具有挑战性。这里我们提出了CGMap，一种可解释的图学习框架，使用面向宽度的并行架构，从生物分子网络中优先筛选潜在CGs并追踪机制线索。通过构建距离分辨通道，CGMap在多个拓扑尺度上定位空间分散的CG信号，同时避免表征同质化。全局扩散模块量化路径上下文中的基因协同性，并产生可追踪的虚拟相互作用，将预测映射到潜在调节假说，为模型决策提供内在可解释性。在泛癌环境下，针对多个生物分子网络，CGMap分析了12,022个基因，始终优于现有方法，同时保持计算效率，并优先筛选出70个可靠候选基因，包括既有数据库中未注释的基因。重要的是，优先筛选的候选基因与抑制与肿瘤相关的表型相关，包括细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭减少，以及上皮-间质转化（EMT）相关特征向非间质状态转移，这由癌细胞和非恶性细胞系中的平行功能丧失实验所支持。Wang et al. 提出了CGMap，一种距离分辨图学习框架，将分散的致癌信号映射为结构化优先级，缩小癌症基因候选空间，并从假设到实际验证建立了可解释的路径。
